Wukong

Jungle Weird but works

Crit Jungle Wukong

How to play this build

On ganks, Decoy (W) leaves a clone that confuses and briefly stealths you to reposition. In teamfights, Cyclone (R) with IE + PD crits the whole team to win fights alone; open with Nimbus Strike (E) + Crushing Blow (Q).

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Golpe Aplastante → E Ataque Nimbo → W Señuelo

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Crushing Blow (Q) for damage and armor shred; Nimbus Strike (E) second for engage mobility. W at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Spirit of the Ancient Golem Tank jungle item: health, tenacity and the Smite buff (jungle sustain).
  2. The Black Cleaver AD and health; your hits stack armor shred on the target.
  3. Infinity Edge High AD, crit and increased crit damage. Core of almost every ADC.
  4. Phantom Dancer Attack speed, crit and move speed; ignores unit collision.
  5. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 gives crit damage with durability to dive the fight.
